{{Top|leg}}
A '''petro-chemical reactant''' was used in [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] [[blister blaster]]. The weapon's [[Slug/Legends|slugs]] were filled with the reactant. When exposed to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] upon impact, the mixture ignited a small area around the target.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
